title: Dukes of Duchesca - Napoli '97
name: dukesofduchesca-napoli97
summary: Top-down car chase across a stylised Napoli, summer 1997: eight party items, one Fiat 500, scooters and police on your tail.
description: Drive a pimped-up white Fiat 500 across a Napoli drawn from memory of a city atlas: the Posillipo promontory, Mergellina and Via Caracciolo, Castel dell'Ovo, the tight grid of the centro storico, the Rettifilo, the station, Capodimonte and Capodichino. Collect the eight things no party can do without, refuel before the tank runs dry, shake off the scooter gangs with the horn, keep clear of the police, and reach the villa at Posillipo before the night is over. Palette-indexed graphics with exact colours on the ESP32-C6, a sunset that turns into night as you play, and an original four-track SID-like soundtrack that speeds up when you are being chased, with stereo-panned effects.
controls: D-Pad UP/DOWN: accelerate, brake and reverse. LEFT/RIGHT: steer. A: horn (scares scooters). START: pause.
content_notice: Freely inspired by a 1980s television car-chase series; not affiliated with its rights holders. Code, art and music are original.
